title: Schedule
description: spec of the Schedule manifest: slots by cron, a time zone, a task and an address (docs/task-language.md, "Schedule").

cron.description: Five cron fields, without CRON_TZ and TZ (TIM-3, TIM-4).

timezone.description: Time zone; without the field Tenant.spec.timezone applies.

task.description: The slot task: a type from the system-ops group.

skip_if_waiting.description: true by default: the slot is skipped while the previous task waits (TIM-3).

proposable.description: Whether a change of the schedule can be proposed; true by default (PRP-10).

locale.description: From v0.2: the language of code texts for the schedule's addresses (DLV-9).
